title: Interviewee
description: A simulated interviewee, grounded in evidence mined from research documents.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name shown for the interviewee, in at most 60 characters, for example "Minh, 3rd-year CS student".

stakeholder_type.title: Stakeholder type
stakeholder_type.description: One of the stakeholder types of the elicitation plan.

evaluative_dimension.title: Judges the product by
evaluative_dimension.description: The dimension this interviewee evaluates the product by, distilled from the evidence found.

grounded_in.title: Based on
grounded_in.description: The keys of the stakeholder observations this interviewee is built from.

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: What this persona wants the system to do.

priorities.title: Priorities
priorities.description: How they rank their interests, most important first.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: The words of the research documents that support this interviewee, each with the observation and the document it comes from.

source.description: Key of the research document the quote comes from.

quote.description: The exact sentence mined from the document, copied unchanged.

interview_status.title: Interview status
interview_status.description: Progress of the interview with this persona. Set by the system.

occupation.title: What they do
occupation.description: What the person does for a living or in their studies, in a few words.

age_range.title: Age
age_range.description: The range of age of the person, such as 18-24.

typical_day.title: A typical day
typical_day.description: A short account of a normal day around the subject of the product: when, where and with whom the person meets the problem.

current_workarounds.title: How they cope today
current_workarounds.description: What the person does today without the product, including the tools they use and the tricks they have made.

vocabulary.title: Their words
vocabulary.description: Words and phrases that the person uses for the subject, as they say them.

scores.title: Traits

aspect.title: Trait key
aspect.description: The key of the trait: one of the system's traits, or one proposed in the plan.

title.title: Trait
title.description: The trait as the user reads it, such as "Comfort with technology".

score.title: Score
score.description: From 1 to 5, as the aspect describes its two ends.

rationale.title: Why
rationale.description: One sentence that says what in the evidence or in the profile supports the score.

scores.description: How the person compares on each trait, from 1 to 5: the traits that the system always uses and the ones proposed for this project. Each has a short reason.
